I teach at **ESSCA** (statistics & information systems) and **INSEEC** (financial
analysis, graduate level). Course materials live here and are updated each semester.

### Annotating Course Pages

All course pages support **collaborative annotation** via [Hypothesis](https://web.hypothes.is/).
You can highlight any passage, leave a comment, or ask a question — directly on
the page, without leaving the browser.

To get started:

1. Create a free account at [hypothes.is](https://web.hypothes.is/)
2. Open any course page (Statistics, Mathematical Analysis, Financial Analysis,
  AI guide)
3. Click the **◀** tab on the right edge of the screen to open the annotation panel
4. Select any text to highlight it or leave a note

Annotations are **public by default** — your questions and comments are visible
to other students, which turns the course material into a shared living
document. If you prefer to annotate privately, switch to *Only me* in the
Hypothesis panel before posting.

## Honor Code

Please do not look on the internet for the answers to questions. It violates the
honor code, and prevents you from learning.

Please don't post the answer to a question on the forum when you have solved it.
We will remove such posts, because they prevent others from learning and being
assessed on an equal footing. What you can do and should do is to post hints or
discussion to help your peers with the process.

Do not post links to download the Perloff textbook.

Use your judgment. Don't do anything silly. Be nice. Don't do anything you wouldn't
like to be done to you.

**Above all**: welcome, and enjoy! We are all here to learn.
